attributes.text: What to have ready before you start.
Walking Lunge is today's variation instead of Split Squat (per side). Each exercise keeps its own level.
Russian Twist is today's variation instead of Side Plank (per side). Each exercise keeps its own level.
Meet a higher level’s targets to make it current. Three successful sessions on distinct days within 14 days earn the next level, or four within 30 days if you train weekly.
